SMTP Client

gxsSMTPClient sends mail over TLS only: implicit TLS on port 465 or STARTTLS on port 587.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

Connect() reads the greeting, sends EHLO and starts TLS. With gxsMAIL_STARTTLS a server that does not offer STARTTLS is refused; mail is never sent in plain text. Login() uses AUTH PLAIN, or AUTH LOGIN when the server offers only that. SendMessage() writes Date, From, To, Subject, Message-ID and MIME headers for a UTF-8 text body; Data() sends any message, normalizing line ends and dot stuffing lines that start with a period. Header values with line breaks are refused.

gxsSMTPClient smtp;
if(smtp.Connect("smtp.example.com", 587, gxsMAIL_STARTTLS) != 0 ||
   smtp.Login("user", "password") != 0 ||
   smtp.SendMessage("me@example.com", { "you@example.com" }, "Hello", "Body text\n") != 0) {
  std::cerr << smtp.Error() << "\n";
}
smtp.Quit();
